08:11 - 10:15 means time A minus time B, interpreted as time-of-day subtraction with wrap-around.  
08:11 is earlier in the day than 10:15, so subtracting a later time from an earlier time yields a negative duration, which we wrap around modulo 24 hours.  

Compute: 08:11 - 10:15 = (8 hours 11 minutes) - (10 hours 15 minutes)  
= (8*60 + 11) - (10*60 + 15) = 491 - 615 = -124 minutes.  
Add 24 hours (1440 minutes): -124 + 1440 = 1316 minutes.  
1316 minutes = 21 hours 56 minutes.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 21:56
